title: American Convention on Human Rights Article 7 — Right to Personal Liberty, Arbitrary Detention and Removal
category: International Aviation / Human Rights / Treaty Law

incident.location: Santiago International Airport (SCL), aboard flight LA8159 and Gate Area, Chile

allegation_summary: Article 7 of the ACHR guarantees the right to personal liberty and security and prohibits arbitrary arrest or imprisonment. In this case: (a) PDI officers physically restrained and removed passenger Disconzi from the aircraft without any lawful basis — the underlying allegation of aggression was disproven by PDI's own CCTV; (b) the passenger was not informed of the reasons for his detention/removal as required by Article 7(4); (c) the removal was arbitrary within the meaning of Article 7(3) — it was based on a false allegation, executed without any judicial or administrative warrant, and enforced by state agents at the behest of a private corporation; (d) the passenger was denied the right under Article 7(6) to recourse to a competent court to challenge the lawfulness of the detention.
